name: Tassili n'Ajjer
description: Tassili n'Ajjer is a vast sandstone plateau in the Algerian Sahara, whose name means "plateau of rivers." Wind has carved its rock into eerie stone "forests" and a lunar-looking landscape. Hidden among them are more than 15,000 prehistoric paintings and engravings, made from about 6000 BC onward, showing animals, herders and a green Sahara long before the desert dried.
